evidence.title: UI-Patterns.com – User Interface Design Pattern Library
UI Design Patterns Library: 170 UX & Persuasive Patterns

name: UI-Patterns.com
summary: Library of 170 user interface and persuasive design patterns with real-world screenshot examples.
description: A reference library of 170 user interface and persuasive design patterns. Each pattern explains the problem it solves, when and how to use it, with real-world examples; a searchable screenshot library adds thousands of implementation examples with filters by color, website and keyword. Includes a blog, conference talks, a weekly newsletter and printed card decks.
contains: 170 user interface and persuasive design patterns
pattern groups: getting input, navigation, dealing with data, social, onboarding, miscellaneous
persuasive groups: cognition, game mechanics, perception and memory, feedback
screenshot library with filters by color, website and keyword
collections incl. lists (100 examples) and error pages (126 examples)
blog, conference talks and weekly newsletter
card decks for sale: $399 printed + digital, $299 digital only
